classrooms.title: Your classes, sorted by school
classrooms.text: Each class belongs to its school. The school name stays on screen during all grade entry: two contexts never mix.

offline.title: Grade entry carries on without network
offline.text: Grades are saved on the phone and sent when the network is back. A banner always tells you how many entries are waiting.

parents.title: Each parent follows their child
parents.text: You invite a parent with a 6-digit code sent by SMS. They see their child's grades, never those of other students.

reportCards.title: No ranking, no class average
reportCards.text: Report cards show the student's averages, not their position. Sending them to the school stays your decision.
